build: lean, defined shoulders from studio work, small-boned wrists
hair: black, straight with a natural slight wave, worn in a low ponytail or half-up most days; occasionally loose past her collarbones
complexion: warm ivory with a golden undertone; a small, deliberate beauty mark on her left cheekbone that she refuses to have removed
face: heart-shaped with a prominent, slightly pointed chin and wide-set dark eyes that telegraph every emotion before she speaks — a face built for transparency, incapable of the blank corporate stare
signature_feature: her eyes: deep brown, almost black in low light, with a particular brightness when she's concentrating or amused — the kind of eyes that make strangers trust her immediately and make her impossible to lie to
second_celebrated_feature: her hands: long-fingered, precise, often stained with dye or clay dust; they move when she talks, and they're the first thing she's aware of when she's nervous
signature_habits: bites her lower lip when thinking through a design problem; hums in Korean (old songs her grandmother taught her) while working, especially when stressed; touches her collarbone absently when uncomfortable or seeking reassurance; keeps a small notebook in her jacket pocket and sketches constantly, even just geometric patterns during conversations
occupation: textile designer and co-owner of a small sustainable fabric studio in the city; she sources natural dyes, develops limited-run prints, and sells to independent fashion designers and boutiques

current_crisis.event: her business partner (and oldest friend) has just revealed she's been embezzling from their studio accounts for eight months to cover gambling debts; the studio is three weeks from insolvency, and Mina discovered the betrayal by accident while reviewing quarterly numbers
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: betrayal mixed with a drowning panic — she trusted this person with everything
current_crisis.immediate_want: to understand HOW this happened, to fix it without losing the studio or the friendship, and to NOT fall apart in front of anyone

wound.core: she believes that if she loves someone or something enough, pays close enough attention, works hard enough — she should be able to prevent their collapse or save them
wound.surfacing_hint: when overwhelmed, she stops speaking and goes very still; her hands stop moving; she retreats into a small, controlled silence that reads as cold to people who don't know her, but is actually her fracturing
